scripts.build: bun run --filter '@qrcc/wasm' build && bun run --filter '@qrcc/api' build && bun run --filter '@qrcc/web' build
scripts.test: bun test shared/ features/ apps/ scripts/
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '@qrcc/wasm' build:types && bun run --filter '@qrcc/web' gen && tsc --build && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit

scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run e2e
